column2: Copying the long list by hand was a tedious job that took the whole afternoon.
column3: 用手抄寫那份長清單是件乏味的差事，花掉整個下午。
column5: tedious 像「踢地獄」：無聊到像被踢進地獄般的長

column2: Taiwan's textile industry makes cloth for sportswear and fashion brands.
column3: 台灣的紡織業替運動服和時尚品牌製造布料。
column5: text 編織 (texture)：把線織成布的

column2: My thrifty mother saves leftover rice and turns it into fried rice.
column3: 我節儉的媽媽把吃剩的飯留起來，做成炒飯。
column5: thrift 節省 + y；thrifty 是會精打細算存錢的人

column2: The tranquil garden was a perfect place to read in the afternoon.
column3: 那座寧靜的花園是午後讀書的絕佳地點。
column5: tranquil 像「穿過裡」：穿過安靜裡面，心很平靜

column2: The triumphant team lifted the trophy and waved to the cheering crowd.
column3: 得意洋洋的球隊舉起獎盃，向歡呼的群眾揮手。
column5: triumph 勝利 + ant：贏了得意的

column2: Don't argue over trivial things like who sat in which seat.
column3: 別為了誰坐哪個座位這種瑣事爭吵。
column5: tri 三 + via 路 → 三條路口閒聊的小事

column2: Palm trees and coral reefs are found in tropic regions near the equator.
column3: 靠近赤道的熱帶地區可以看到棕櫚樹和珊瑚礁。
column5: tropic 像「吹太陽」：吹著太陽的熱帶

column2: The truant student spent the afternoon at the arcade instead of going to class.
column3: 那個逃學的學生整個下午泡在遊樂場，沒有去上課。
column5: truant 像「出狼」：出走不去上學的小狼

column2: She made the utmost effort to finish the race despite the sore leg.
column3: 儘管腿很痛，她仍竭盡全力跑完比賽。
column5: ut 外 + most 最 → 已經是最外面、最極致

column2: The valiant firefighter ran into the smoke to rescue a trapped kitten.
column3: 勇敢的消防員衝進濃煙，救出受困的小貓。
column5: val 力量 (value)：有力量的，勇敢

column2: A versatile actor can play a funny clown, a king, or a quiet teacher.
column3: 多才多藝的演員可以演搞笑小丑、國王，或是安靜的老師。
column5: vers 轉 (reverse)：容易轉換角色的

column2: The vicious rumor hurt her feelings and spread all over the school.
column3: 那則惡毒的謠言傷了她的心，還傳遍了整個學校。
column5: vice 惡行 + ious：滿是惡意的

column2: We held a virtual meeting online because everyone lived in a different city.
column3: 因為大家住在不同城市，所以我們在線上開了虛擬會議。
column5: virtual 像「微秋」：微縮在螢幕裡的虛擬世界

column2: Singing needs good vocal control, so the choir teacher trains our voices daily.
column3: 唱歌需要良好的聲音控制，所以合唱團老師天天訓練我們的聲音。
column5: voc 聲音 (voice)：跟聲音有關的

column2: After junior high, Leo entered a vocational school to learn to cook.
column3: 國中畢業後，阿里歐進入職業學校學習烹飪。
column5: voc 召喚 + ational：被職業召喚去學技能

column2: The teacher asked him to stop using vulgar words in the playground.
column3: 老師要求他在操場上別再說粗俗的字眼。
column5: vulgar 像「瓦格」：瓦格貨，沒水準、粗俗

column2: The explorers kept their supplies in a watertight bag during the boat trip.
column3: 探險隊在划船旅程中把補給品放在防水袋裡。
column5: water 水 + tight 緊 → 水一滴也進不去

column2: I have no interest whatsoever in joining the school's cooking contest.
column3: 我對參加學校的烹飪比賽完全沒有興趣。
column5: what 什麼 + so + ever：不管是什麼都一樣

column2: Her witty reply made the whole class laugh and the teacher smile.
column3: 她風趣的回答讓全班大笑，老師也笑了。
column5: witty 像「Wit 威提」：頭腦轉得快的機智人

column2: Please abbreviate "Wednesday" as "Wed." so the schedule fits on one page.
column3: 請把「Wednesday」縮寫成「Wed.」，這樣時間表才放得進一頁。
column5: ab 向 + brev 短 → 弄短

column2: Some customers abuse the free refill rule by pouring drinks into big bottles.
column3: 有些顧客濫用免費續杯規定，把飲料倒進大瓶子裡。
column5: ab 離開 + use 用 → 用錯了路

column2: Don't let video games addict you; take breaks and go outside.
column3: 別讓電玩使你沉迷；要休息並出去走走。
column5: addict 像「愛點」：愛點個不停就上癮了

column2: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient every four hours.
column3: 護理師每四小時會給病人用一次藥。
column5: ad 向 + minister 服務 → 把東西送上

column2: A committee will administrate the school fund and report its spending each month.
column3: 一個委員會將管理學校基金，並每月報告支出。
column5: administrate 與 administer 同族，指管理運作

column2: The captain affirmed that the ship would leave on time despite the storm.
column3: 船長斷言這艘船即使有暴風雨也會準時出發。
column5: af 向 + firm 堅固 → 說得很堅定

column2: Hunters in the forest planned to ambush the bear near the stream.
column3: 森林裡的獵人計畫在溪邊埋伏那頭熊。
column5: ambush 的 bush 是灌木叢：躲在灌木叢裡等

column2: A microphone can amplify your voice so the whole hall can hear it.
column3: 麥克風可以放大你的聲音，讓整個大廳都聽得到。
column5: ample 寬大 + ify 使 → 使變大

column2: In the history book, a group of men plotted to assassinate the king, but failed.
column3: 在歷史書裡，一群人密謀暗殺國王，但失敗了。
column5: assassinate 前面 ass + ass：兩個 ass 重疊，記雙 s 雙 s

column2: A teacher will assess your essay and give you a score and advice.
column3: 老師會評估你的作文，並給你分數與建議。
column5: as 向 + sess 坐 → 坐在旁邊評量

column2: With daily practice, she attained the highest score in the spelling contest.
column3: 每天練習，使她在拼字比賽中獲得最高分。
column5: at 向 + tain 觸及 → 伸手摸到目標

column2: The museum will auction a rare painting to raise money for the school.
column3: 博物館將拍賣一幅罕見的畫，為學校籌款。
column5: auction 像「喔喜」：喔，喜歡就舉手出價

column2: The author autographed my copy of her book at the book fair.
column3: 作家在書展上於我的那本書上簽了名。
column5: auto 自己 + graph 寫 → 自己寫下名字

column2: The coach beckoned the player to the sideline with a wave of his hand.
column3: 教練揮手示意球員到場邊來。
column4: beckon someone over (招手叫某人過來)
column5: beckon 像「必空」：必須空出手來向人招呼

column2: Fans besieged the singer's car, hoping for a photo.
column3: 歌迷包圍了歌手的車，希望能拍到一張照片。
column5: be 加強 + siege 圍城 → 團團圍住

column2: He blundered by sending the private message to the whole group.
column3: 他把私人訊息傳給整個群組，犯了大錯。
column5: blunder 像「搬動」：搬錯東西，犯下大錯

column2: Reporters bombard the mayor with questions after every press conference.
column3: 每次記者會結束後，記者都不斷向市長丟出問題。
column5: bomb 炸彈 + ard：像丟炸彈般一個接一個

column2: A warm cup of soup can boost your mood on a rainy day.
column3: 下雨天一杯熱湯能提振你的心情。
column5: boost 像「不死」：朝上推，士氣不死

column2: Many shoppers decided to boycott the brand after it polluted the river.
column3: 許多消費者在該品牌汙染河川後，決定聯合抵制它。
column5: boycott 的 boy 男孩 + cot 小床：大家不躺在他的床

column2: Dad likes to brew a pot of green tea every evening.
column3: 爸爸喜歡每天傍晚泡一壺綠茶。
column5: brew 像「布魯」：布魯布魯冒泡，在煮茶或釀啤酒

column2: The old chair began to buckle under the heavy bag, then fell apart.
column3: 那張舊椅子在沉重的袋子壓力下開始垮掉，然後散開。
column4: buckle under pressure (在壓力下垮掉)
column5: buckle 是皮帶扣：扣緊或被壓彎
